items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore suffered AC joint sprain/shoulder injury Thursday night; ruled out of game. Doctors: not serious, day-to-day with chance to play next week vs Chargers but not a lock.
items.why: AC sprain from hard landing; X-rays/stinger; Schefter/Rapoport confirm non-serious but status air for Week 3.
items.implication: Fast-start WR sidelined short-term; monitor for next week.
items.opportunity: Other Bills WRs/TE targets rise in interim.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey DNP second straight day (ribs); unlikely available Sunday vs Raiders.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; consecutive DNPs make availability improbable.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; target share opens.
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston and depth WRs elevated snaps/routes.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Thursday after DNP Wednesday; second straight miss. If OUT, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore. Ja'Kobi Lane on IR/return (wrist).
items.why: Re-aggravated hamstring in Week 1; consecutive DNPs; day-to-day but low play probability.
items.implication: WR1 usage vacuum; Lamar Jackson target distribution changes.

items.text: Nico Collins hurt his hamstring in Wednesday practice (history of missing 5 games in 2024); MRI results pending. Ran 37 of 42 routes on Stroud dropbacks in Week 1. Status in jeopardy for Week 2 vs CIN; DNP Thursday after limited Wednesday, Grade 1 strain.
items.why: Hamstring strain with prior history; DNP Thursday; doctors say not serious but Week 2 availability jeopardized per Schefter.
items.implication: High-end WR2 at risk; monitor Friday practice closely.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets shift to Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel/Schultz if OUT.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson 'ready to go' after ankle; returning at right time. Unclear snap/carry share vs Rhamondre Stevenson, but Patriots desperate for explosives with AJ Brown on IR. Nice upcoming schedule (PIT/JAX/BUF/LV etc before bye).
items.why: Full participant; self-declared ready; offense needs juice post-Brown IR.
items.implication: Committee but explosive upside; FLEX candidate.
items.opportunity: Carries/routes expansion possible vs Stevenson; schedule boost.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers DNP again (knee surgery/meniscus); yet to practice since procedure. Status uncertain vs Chargers.
items.why: Meniscus trim; no practice post-surgery; expected 1-2 games miss originally.
items.implication: TE1 void; Michael Mayer primary option.

items.text: Kenneth Walker 24% target share (tied team lead, 2nd-highest career) in Chiefs debut; 21/24 RB touches early. LOVE vs IND; RB1 overall in range of outcomes if healthy.
items.why: Elite early usage + target share in new offense; Indy soft vs RBs.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty Utilization Score 99 in first game under Kubiak (2nd only to Bijan). LOVE; overreaction to injury scare fading.
Dak Prescott on Week 2 LOVE despite Week 1; home vs WAS (torched for 14.5 YPC/3 TDs); top-5 implied total.
items.why: Elite home form + soft secondary matchup + high total.

items.text: Devonta Smith on Week 2 LOVE list despite tough Week 1; bounce-back expected.
Bucky Irving career-high 26% target share + 8 more routes than Gainwell + both RB RZ touches in shared backfield. LOVE.
Colston Loveland 89% route participation (highest TE Week 1); 0 points/2 targets but missed end-zone looks. Buy low if owner panics; UPGRADE.
items.why: Elite route rate in high-scoring Bears offense; volume coming.
items.conflict: Bad Week 1 box score vs usage.

items.text: Dalton Kincaid 69% routes (higher than any 2025 game) and 77% snaps (highest since 2024 W9). LOVE if healthy role sticks; efficient TE breakout candidate.
items.why: Expanded role post-injury; per-target efficiency history.

items.text: Harold Fannin 14% target share (lowest completed game since W5 2025) and low yards; HATE. More competition from Concepcion/Boston + Watson QB issues.
items.why: Declining share + added target competition + poor QB.
